EmailTemplate.subject: About your certification request
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thanks for your interest in Flywire Security requesting our SOC II and PCI. We're committed to making the global payment experience effortless and safe for you and your payers.
Please sign and return the Non Disclosure Agreement to security@flywire.com <[[mailto:security@flywire.com]]> and we will process your request and notify your relationship manager as quickly as possible.
Download NDA <[[https://assets.flywire.com/documents/Flywire-Mutual-NDA-Form.pdf]]>
Thank you, The Flywire Team
